volume_by_day_version: SELECT toDate(timestamp) AS day,properties.app_version AS version,event,count() AS events FROM events WHERE distinct_id != 'analytics-development' AND coalesce(properties.distribution_channel,'') != 'local-development' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY GROUP BY day,version,event ORDER BY day DESC,events DESC
foreground_activity_by_language: SELECT toDate(timestamp) AS day,properties.ui_language AS language,properties.app_version AS version,uniqExact(distinct_id) AS foreground_installations FROM events WHERE distinct_id != 'analytics-development' AND coalesce(properties.distribution_channel,'') != 'local-development' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND event='app_opened' GROUP BY day,language,version ORDER BY day DESC,foreground_installations DESC
account_close_observations: SELECT properties.dialog_phase AS phase,properties.form_valid AS form_valid,properties.submission_blocked AS submission_blocked,properties.verification_required AS verification_required,properties.detection_pending AS detection_pending,properties.save_pending AS save_pending,count() AS observations,uniqExact(distinct_id) AS installations FROM events WHERE distinct_id != 'analytics-development' AND coalesce(properties.distribution_channel,'') != 'local-development' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND event='account_dialog_closed' GROUP BY phase,form_valid,submission_blocked,verification_required,detection_pending,save_pending ORDER BY observations DESC
copy_key_outcomes: SELECT properties.app_version AS version,properties.result AS result,properties.failure_stage AS stage,properties.error_category AS category,properties.fallback_used AS fallback_used,count() AS observations FROM events WHERE distinct_id != 'analytics-development' AND coalesce(properties.distribution_channel,'') != 'local-development' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND event='feature_action_completed' AND properties.action_id='copy_api_key' GROUP BY version,result,stage,category,fallback_used ORDER BY observations DESC
